y.label: Supported
y.meaning: Evidence supports this atomic capability for the exact target and qualifiers.

a.label: Partial / conditional
a.meaning: Some behavior works, but scope, preview status, plan, policy, transport, role, or revision limits full support.

n.label: Not supported
n.meaning: Evidence explicitly shows absence or incompatibility for the target.

u.label: Unknown
u.meaning: No sufficiently specific evidence was captured; never infer support from brand-level marketing.
